name: Stillfront Group AB (publ)
summary: Stillfront Group AB (publ), together with its subsidiaries, designs, develops, markets, publishes, and sells digital games in Europe, North America, the Middle East and North Africa, and the Asia-Pacific. Its games portfolio include Supremacy 1914, Call of War: World War 2, Adult Coloring Book, Goodgame Empire, BitLife, Conflict of Nations: World War 3, Goodgame Big Farm, Sunshine Island Adventure Farm, Jawaker, Warhammer, Shishinogotoku, Empire, and Imperia.
